problem: Kode error E001 — No reset
solution: Click the [Reset] button to reset.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E002 — No X zero signal
solution: Inspect the X sensor for poor contact or breakage
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E003 — No Y zero signal
solution: Inspect the Y sensor for poor contact or breakage
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E004 — No Z zero signal
solution: Inspect the Z sensor for poor contact or breakage
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E005 — No U zero signal
solution: Inspect the U sensor for poor contact or breakage
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E006 — Extended shaft infinite bit signal
solution: Inspect the shaft sensor for poor contact or breakage
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E007 — No spindle zero signal
solution: Check the spindle encoder for breakage
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E205 — Pressure frame fails to come down
solution: Click the "Press the frame" button to place the frame.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E206 — Head board failure
solution: The head plate has broken. It is necessary to change the broken head plate with a new one.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E207 — Input I/O timeout error
solution: Check whether the input IO has "high" or "low" of the input signal.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E208 — Insufficient air pressure
solution: Check whether the air supply unit supplies air normally.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E209 — Clipper motor is not at the correct position
solution: Check whether the zero signal of the clipper motor is normal.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E210 — Presser motor is not at the correct position
solution: Check that the zero signal of the presser foot motor is normal.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E211 — Wire grab motor is not at the correct position
solution: Check whether the zero line signal of the wire grab motor is normal.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E212 — Cutter is not at the correct position
solution: Check whether the zero signal of the cutter motor is nor- mal.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E213 — Wire breaks
solution: Execute the thread again or turn OFF the wire break detection function before proceeding the operation.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E214 — Number of jobs is too many
solution: Counted value on the counter has reached the total number you have set. The total number on the counter is cleared and the counter re-starts counting by re-starting the operation.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E215 — Bottom line has been already used up
solution: It is necessary to change the bobbin thread hook.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E216 — File size is too large
solution: The number of pins in the graphics file has exceeded the maximum range. The current graphics file must be changed with a new one.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E217 — Work file is not found
solution: It is necessary to re-scan or change over the graphics file.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E218 — Waiting for the work data
solution: Queuing time for processing graphic data differs with the size of graphic
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E219 — Electrical failure. Contact the manufacturer.
solution: Contact the manufacturer of the equipment
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E220 — Wrong upgrade file
solution: It is necessary to replace the upgrade file with the new upgrade file.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E221 — Error has occurred during upgrading of the file type
solution: It is necessary to select the correct type of upgrade file for the file to be upgraded
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E222 — Not yet upgraded
solution: Contact the manufacturer of the equipment
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E223 — It is not an upgrade file made by the same OEM
solution: Contact the manufacturer of the equipment
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E224 — Cannot be connected to the head board
solution: Inspect the head board for poor contact of the head board connection line and / or breakage of the desk head plate
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E225 — Connect to the main board
solution: If the mother board for the display or the electric cord has broken though the screen line connection is neither poor nor broken, check that replacement of the broken part is necessary.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E226 — The current file is not valid
solution: It is necessary to change the graphics file if the graphical file has broken or the file is not intended to be used with this system type.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E227 — File transfer has failed
solution: If the mother board for the display or the electric cord has broken though the screen line connection is neither poor nor broken, check that replacement of the broken part is necessary.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E228 — Data out of range
solution: Check whether the current graphics file data is defective exceeding the ignorable range.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E229 — This adjustment angle is too large
solution: Corrected graphic angle is too large. Decrease the changed angle value.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E230 — Reading of graphics
solution: Process the necessary graphic data. Then, wait for a while before starting operation.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E231 — Presser foot error
solution: Check whether the presser foot motor is normal.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E232 — U disk has not been detected
solution: Re-insert the U disk or replace the U disk with a new one.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E233 — File reading / writing error
solution: ① Replace the graphics file with a different one. ② Re-insert the U disk or replace the U disk with a new one.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E234 — Graphics out of range or head offset
solution: ① Reset the position of reference point. ② Reset the offset value of the head 2 or head 3. ③ Replace the small-width graphic with the normal-width graphic.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E235 — This file is not a file to be processed
solution: Replace the graphics file with a different one.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E236 — Ferroelectric damage
solution: Contact the manufacturer of the equipment
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E237 — Set an administration password
solution: Firstly, set the administration password.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E238 — Edit is not supported
solution: Command or file that is not required to be edited
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E239 — Contact the manufacturer
solution: Contact the manufacturer of the equipment
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E240 — Communication fault 2
solution: CAN communication error has occurred, or the motherboard program is old one.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E241 — At the time of fault
solution: ① Time has been modified illegally. ② Motherboard battery voltage is low.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E242 — No job IO
solution: ① Work enable input IO signal is abnormal. ② Shut down the "Work enable input IO" function. Set the parameter value to 0 (zero).
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E243 — Input waiting IO
solution: Waiting for the input IO signal in the graphics file.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E244 — Delay is executed
solution: Delay command is executed with the graphics file.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E245 — File name is too long
solution: It is necessary to shorten the file name.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E246 — Lift the presser foot in advance
solution: It is necessary to lift the presser foot by clicking the "Presser foot" button.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E247 — Frame is not pressed
solution: It is necessary to press the frame in advance.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E248 — Auxiliary pressure frame is not pressed
solution: It is necessary to firstly press the auxiliary pressure frame.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E249 — Pressure frame and auxiliary pressure frame are not pressed
solution: It is necessary to push down all of the back pressure blocks.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.

problem: Kode error E250 — Punched bottom material has run out
solution: It is necessary to replace the material to be punched with a new one.
source: JUKI PS-800-12080 Instruction Manual, bagian 4-26, List of error codes, halaman 46-50.
